highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.156.2 update corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
highlights_body: These same-milestone native fixes also align image-filter cache lookups with hashing, without changing managed APIs.

bullets.lead: Keep antialiased image sampling within bounds
bullets.detail: Ganesh image draws and filters constrain sampling to the intended texture subset under minification, strong skew, AA clipping and MSAA, preventing unrelated backing-texture pixels from contaminating the output.
Cache equality now matches bytewise hashing for signed zero, matrix type metadata and subnormal values, keeping lookups and eviction consistent.

Mask-filtered text uses the reloaded glyph's path and validates mask compatibility when successive font-scaler loads differ. This prevents stale outlines and sub-byte buffer overwrites, and corrects clipped embossed-mask planes.
